load.mode: Fresh VM each time, no snapshot/prewarm; uncontrolled host load/page cache. Closed loop waits durable old GC before next switch; does NOT saturate queues or prove cross-tenant fairness. load.quantile_method: empirical nearest rank; P99 is max for fewer than100 samples, not a tail/SLO guarantee
load.resource_note: 20ms observer. RSS is sampled proc-status resident memory, not PSS; owned-process sums and cgroup-memory-current are non-transactional and can miss peaks. Cgroup memory includes page cache/kernel, NOT guest RSS alone. Tombstone metadata intentionally grows up to configured budget. This finite probe does not prove asymptotic memory stability.
